gm_text: Rain spatters the soot-dark stones above the eastern gate of Cinderwatch, where frayed banners shudder in the chill wind. A well-appointed townhouse overlooks the bustling square, its noble colors standing in quiet contrast to the mud and clamoring masses below. Refugees, laden wagons, and travelers clog the muddy approach, pressed tightly by guards who maintain a determined choke point amid the push. Near a rain barrel, a tavern runner calls out offers of hot stew and paid rumors, hoping to turn the uneasy crowd’s attention into coin. A figure clad in threadbare clothing stands oddly still apart from the line, their gaze flicking with keen scrutiny among packs and faces, betraying a watchfulness at odds with the rest. A notice board near the gate lists new taxes and curfew rules, though the most eye-catching entry is a somber warning about a missing patrol, casting a shadow over the crowded scene.
